findings.message: A first-hand testing or verification claim with no evidence block (who tested, when, what) in the post; add the evidence or rewrite it as sourced reporting.
The post has an affiliate link but no affiliate disclosure (FTC 16 CFR 255; site rule).

findings.quote: Our editors rode the cable car at opening time on three separate mornings to confirm the queue times quoted here, and the first departures were consistently the calmest.
findings.why: The post claims first-hand testing with no evidence heading, no test log, and no queue times actually quoted anywhere in the post.
findings.fix: Remove the testing claim or add a real 'How we tested' section with dates and data, and drop the reference to quoted queue times.

findings.quote: Plan your last evening around the Friday night market at the harbourside, where food stalls and live music fill the quay.
findings.why: The prose says Friday but the table lists the Harbourside Night Market on Thursday 17:00 to 21:00, so readers could arrive on the wrong day.
findings.fix: Confirm the market day with an official source and make the text and table agree.

findings.quote: | Harbourside Night Market | Harbourside Market Trust | Thursday 17:00 to 21:00 | Free entry |
findings.why: The organiser 'Harbourside Market Trust' and the market's schedule cannot be verified and no source is linked for it.
findings.fix: Add an official source for the market organiser, day and hours.

findings.quote: | Full-day peninsula tour | Peninsula Day Tours | 08:00 | ZAR 1,150 |
findings.why: The price and departure time are stated as checked, but the only linked source is a generic 'tour overview' page whose address does not indicate a price list, and the operator is unverified.
findings.fix: Link the operator's current price page next to the figure or remove the price and mark it as indicative.

findings.quote: | Winelands hop shuttle | Vine Line Shuttles | 09:30 | ZAR 690 |
findings.why: The source is a 'timetable' page, which may back the departure time but not the ZAR 690 price, and the operator is unverified.
findings.fix: Cite a pricing page for the fare or drop the price, and verify the operator exists.

findings.why: The prices were checked about two months before today and may have changed, and the claim is not backed by any evidence.
findings.fix: Re-check the prices and update the date, or state the source and check date next to each price.

findings.quote: Summer, from November to March, brings long light evenings, dry weather and strong afternoon winds.
findings.why: Seasonality is broadly right for the southern hemisphere, but the best-time figures have no source.
findings.fix: Add a weather or tourism-board source for the seasonal claims.

findings.quote: If you want settled, dry weather for hiking, plan for May to August, when the mountain trails are quiet and the air is crisp.
findings.why: May to August is Cape Town's cold, wet winter, which contradicts 'settled, dry weather' and the post's own statement that winter is wetter; dry hiking weather is in summer.
findings.fix: Recommend roughly November to March (or the shoulder months) for dry hiking weather, and describe winter as wetter with clear spells.

findings.why: This is an affiliate link with no nearby affiliate disclosure and an unnamed guesthouse.
findings.fix: Name the property and add a disclosure such as 'may earn a commission' near the link.

findings.quote: Wind is the main reason cable cars pause, so check conditions before you queue.
findings.why: The claim is plausible, and the cableway status link is the only supporting source, so it is not clearly attributed.
findings.fix: Link the cableway status page inline next to this statement.
